repositoryAudit.formalConsumer: nearestRealResistance reads f.targetPrice before priorHigh20/priorHigh60/local pivots and applies the same > entry*1.01 eligibility rule.
repositoryAudit.normalizationBehavior: normalizeEnrichmentPayload preserves each custom stock item as-is, so targetPrice and arbitrary companion fields can pass through if supplied.
repositoryAudit.marketConsensusNote: data/market-consensus.json may mention analyst target prices in human-readable basis text, but V7.5.30 only applies source-count consensus bonus and does not map target-price numbers into f.targetPrice.

sourceFailureSemantics.apiFetchFailure: caught; custom becomes empty and after-market scan continues with official enrichment
sourceFailureSemantics.possibleFormalConsequence: If targetPrice is actually supplied only by custom enrichment, a source failure can remove that resistance candidate and change TARGET/LOW_RR/TARGET_NULL state without changing Formal code.

observabilityAudit.whyInsufficient: official enrichment alone can make enrichmentAvailable=true and enrichmentStocks nonzero; those fields cannot prove custom source success or targetPrice coverage.

productionInference.safeStatement: The runtime can consume targetPrice if a custom enrichment source provides it, but current durable evidence does not prove whether Production currently receives it or with what provenance.

next: Use prospective source-state receipts before attributing target-null or RR scarcity to geometry. Until then, targetPrice coverage/source-quality remains UNKNOWN.
